title: RACI (T12)
intro: Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed per deliverable and governance role.
rule: Each deliverable needs exactly one accountable: A or A/R (counts as one). A cell holds A, R, C, I, A/R or nothing. A row is saved as one change.
legend: R = Responsible, A = Accountable, C = Consulted, I = Informed, A/R = Accountable and Responsible.

add.title: Add a deliverable
add.description: Choose the role of each governance role for the new deliverable. Exactly one accountable is required.
add.exceptionHint: Only when a documented governance rule permits more or fewer than one accountable (at least 10 characters).
